list.title: Service accounts
list.description: Accounts for external systems such as CI and build pipelines. They cannot sign in to the console and only call the external API with API tokens.

create.title: Create service account
create.description: Create API tokens in its details after it is created. Its roles decide what its tokens can do.

delete.title: Delete service account
delete.confirm: After deleting "{{name}}", its {{count}} active tokens stop working immediately. Deleted service accounts cannot be restored.

role.hint: Its API tokens can do at most what these roles allow. You can only assign permissions you hold.
role.stale: Someone else just changed this service account's roles; your selection is based on outdated data. Switch to the latest roles before saving.

detail.title: Service account
detail.tokensHint: Tokens only work with the external API and are shown only once when created.

deactivate.title: Disable service account
deactivate.confirm: After disabling "{{name}}", its {{count}} active tokens stop working immediately and do not come back when it is enabled again. You will need to create new tokens.
